text:
marta: Big news 389 308389 I'm moving to Berlin in three weeks & got promoted to Staff Eng. Low-key farewell/promo potluck Friday 5pm in the lounge?
owen: Wait what!! Congrats x2 631389 Count me in for lasagna.
kira: Yesss congrats Marta!! 64c60d I'll bring a salad and a little card.
sam: Congrats!!! 973 Also what time should we sign the card? Will bring sparkling water.
rafa: I'll DJ the playlist for a quick send-off, and bring empanadas. Any dietary restrictions?
people-ops-bot: people-ops: We'll print a farewell card that says "Congrats Marta 389 Staff Eng & good luck in Berlin!" Card will be on the table. Please sign by 4:50pm Friday. Gift budget: $100.
remote-crew-bot: Remote folks: e-card link here for messages and GIFs: https://ecard.example.com/marta. Also remote colleagues are sending a group video.
cafe-coordinator: For potluck logistics: we can provide plates/napkins/utensils and set up a small tea/coffee station. If you want catered warm food, we need a headcount by Wednesday noon.
marta: Thanks everyone! No heavy allergens in my household, but please include at least one DF option for Kira's partner (they're visiting).
owen: I'll sign up for lasagna (feeds 8).
kira: I'll bring mixed greens (DF).
sam: Sparkling water + some cookies? I'll grab DF cookies.
rafa: Empanadas (meat + veggie) 355. I'll bring biodegradable plates too.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: pooled gift form https://forms.example.com/gift-marta due Thu EOD. People-ops will collect.
cafe-coordinator: Estimated set-up cost if ordering: $55 for warm trays + service. Otherwise volunteers fine.
marta: Would love a small group gift if anyone's up for it (bike lock or transit card). No pressure.
owen: Transit card + goodbye note sounds perfect. Happy to chip in.
kira: RSVP: me, ow, sam, rafa, marta, priya (remote), lee (remote).
sam: Calendar invite made: Farewell & Congrats 389 Fri 5pm (Organizer: marta). Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/0xmarta
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: card printed, pooled gift form open, catering decision Wed noon.
rafa: I'll bring a little banner: "Auf Wiedersehen Marta!" and a tiny Berlin flag.
marta: I'm honestly so touched 62d60a Thank you all. See you Friday 1e91ea
remote-crew-bot: Remote team video will be uploaded to the e-card by Thu.
people-ops-bot: Final checklist: card printed, e-card live, potluck signup in thread.
sam: Potluck signup summary: Lasagna (owen), Salad (kira), Empanadas (rafa), Sparkling water & cookies (sam), Banner (rafa), Plates/utensils (cafe-coordinator).
kira: Also quick note: Marta asked that photos are internal only 464.
owen: Got it. Internal only.
marta: Seriously thank you 970 can't wait to celebrate one last time with you all.
